crossRefs.note: He had a son, whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a better…
But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I…
A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.

translations.web: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
translations.bsb: So they ran and brought Saul, and when he stood among the people, he was a head taller than any of the others.
translations.kjv: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
translations.asv: And they ran and fetched him thence; and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
